Stage.LogText: {=sp_gt1_s0_log}You spared the deep wing courier and chose to heed his warnings of false wars. With {Dost.Name}'s suspicion aroused, you must lay low and blend into the shadows. Wait for the heat to die down... (1 Day)

{=sp_gt1_s1_log}A black pigeon landed under your cloak, bearing word that the Shadow Roost recognizes your defiance of {Dost.Name}'s false wars. Travel to {GolgeSehri_Link} and speak with the Shadow Courier {GolgeUlagi_Link}.

{=sp_gt1_s2_log}The courier confirmed {Dost.Name}'s fabrications. Prove your resolve for the Shadow Council: Ambush and eliminate the 50-man foreign detachment {RakipAjanlar_Link} awaiting leaked dispatches near {GolgeSiginagi_Link}.

{=sp_gt1_s_success_log}You destroyed the foreign detachment. The Shadow Roost approved your lethality and determination. You are no longer a blind pawn of {Dost.Name}; you are an initiate of the shadows. You received the 'Shadow Bone Dagger' and 30,000 denars.

DialogNode.Text: {=sp_gt1_dlg1_p}I was guided here by a black pigeon after sparing the inner courier.
{=sp_gt1_dlg1}You spared the courier who ordered {Dost.Name}'s execution... The Shadow Roost watched your choice closely.
{=sp_gt1_dlg1}You spared the courier who ordered {Dost.Name}'s execution... The Shadow Roost watched your choice closely.
{=sp_gt1_dlg_p1_inq}Who are you, and why do you hide in the shadows while {Dost.Name} parades as the savior of the Motherland?
{=sp_gt1_dlg_p1_skep}The courier claimed you seek truth, yet here I find another ring of spies. Why should I trust your words?
{=sp_gt1_dlg_p1_prag}I spared him because his documents were genuine. Where does the true power lie in this conspiracy?
{=sp_gt1_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_gt1_dlg_u_origin}We are the Shadow Roost, the ancient circle that founded the Scavenger Pigeons a century ago. We were born to keep greedy kings from destroying Calradia. But {Dost.Name} turned our brotherhood into his personal slaughterhouse and profit engine!
{=sp_gt1_dlg_p2_wars}Manufactured wars... Can a single lord truly manipulate entire kingdoms into mutual slaughter for gold?
{=sp_gt1_dlg_p2_comp}And where was this exalted Roost while {Dost.Name} traded lives? Were you blind, or simply complicit?
{=sp_gt1_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_gt1_dlg_u_mechanics}{Dost.Name} systematically isolated our cells and poisoned the elders who questioned his blood taxes. He hired deserters to raid frontier villages under enemy banners, forcing kings into panic so they pay fortunes for Pigeon intelligence!
{=sp_gt1_dlg_p3_task}The courier spoke of a foreign force. What is their role in {Dost.Name}'s grand design?
{=sp_gt1_dlg_p3_risk}Attacking an armed foreign detachment near a mountain hideout could spark an open war with the local garrison.
{=sp_gt1_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_gt1_dlg_u_test}A 50-man foreign detachment waits near {GolgeSiginagi_Link} to purchase {Dost.Name}'s stolen realm defense blueprints! If that intelligence crosses the frontier, thousands will burn. Slay them all. Let {Dost.Name} find only cold steel where he expected gold!
{=sp_gt1_dlg3}{Dost.Name}'s lies end now. Their blood will water the mountain. (Accept Mission)
{=sp_gt1_dlg3_prag}Fifty foreign deserters will fall beneath my steel. The Shadow Roost better have gold ready when I return. (Accept Mission)
{=sp_gt1_dlg3_inq}If {Dost.Name} is trading with foreign powers, destroying this detachment will strike at his core. I will ride immediately. (Accept Mission)
{=sp_gt1_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_gt1_dlg_agents_intro}You are intruding on private negotiations, Calradian! Lower your weapons or be put down!
{=sp_gt1_dlg_agents_p1}Those stolen defense blueprints stay on this side of the mountains! (Fight)
{=sp_gt1_dlg_agents_p2}No foreign mercenaries buy Calradian secrets while I draw breath! (Fight)
